title: Penalty for sale or delivery of commodities, etc., by non-standard weight or measure
text:
34. Penalty for sale or delivery of commodities, etc., by non-standard weight or measure.—

Whoever sells, or causes to be sold, delivers, or causes to be delivered, any commodity, article or thing by
any means other than the standard weight or measure or number, shall be punished with [fine which may
extend to twenty-five thousand rupees and for the second offence with fine which may extend to fifty
thousand rupees and for the third and subsequent offence, with fine which may extend to one lakh
rupees].
